reviewerRole: independent QA subagent; no asset generation or game integration

artReview.method: Direct visual inspection of every final full-resolution v3 PNG and the v3 final light/dark alpha-composited 192px-high contact sheet; compare face, hair, pose, silhouette and costume. Male01 is human-approved; QA checks its technical usability.
rejectedAndReplaced: entire first batch: user rejected ordinary/stiff direction
entire v2 batch: user requested stylized 2D designed protagonist costumes
first v3 male04: too close to male01 face and crane/diamond costume template; regenerated

criteria.frontalDominantFullBodyAndFeet: pass; slight natural torso turns retained, no profile/back views
criteria.distinctFacesHairSilhouettesAndAccessori: pass after four same-face/costume candidates were regenerated
criteria.coherentWuxiaHandPaintedArt: pass; stylized 2D linework/color planes and designed cloth/leather/metal details; no magical glow
criteria.transparentEdgesOnLightAndDark: pass; apparent RGB halos in uncomposited preview were independently checked as alpha-zero pixels, then cleared by composited inspection
criteria.smallScaleRecognition: pass at 192px contact-sheet height and actual creation screenshots
criteria.creationStoryScope: pass for creation portrait presentation; battle art remains untouched and is not certified

notes: Male01 was explicitly approved by the human; its art direction was not reversed by QA.
Male01/female01 form a coherent crane-themed martial-school pair; the other six have distinct costume motifs and silhouettes.
Most portraits have little top/bottom padding; existing contain rendering and full feet were verified in actual browser screenshots.

assetVerification.independentSourceAndRuntimeSha256: all eight final v3 source/runtime SHA256 values independently matched to current asset report using hashlib
assetVerification.decodedPixelComparison: independently reopened all eight PNG/WebP pairs using bundled Pillow; dimensions are identical 1024x1536 and every decoded RGBA byte is equal
assetVerification.dimensions: all eight browser-decoded WebP images are 1024x1536
assetVerification.runtimeFormat: WebP; all eight actual HTTP responses were 200 and image.decode succeeded
assetVerification.alpha: light/dark compositing verified visually; masters preserved without crop/resize

browserVerification.environment: Windows headless Chrome via CDP, actual local production index and hashed bundles; deterministic new-account Firebase Auth/Cloud/Session transport fixture
assertions: real pointer clicks on both gender buttons and all four existing element controls
expected new WebP src for every choice
full feet and uncropped silhouette in screenshots

network.observations: A favicon.ico 404 and canceled speculative/repeated requests during selection/reload are recorded separately. All eight portraits have successful HTTP200 responses and successful visible-image decodes; cancellation is not used as success evidence.

browserVerification.cache: new asset filenames remain wired in initial HTML, creation mapping, startup preload and first-play manifest; regenerated first-play hashes verified by build and actual reload displays v3 WebP. Local fixture serves no-store, so persistent production cache/service-worker behavior remains deployment acceptance.

scopeReview.oldAssets: retained; inventory continues using original JPEGs and battle uses its separate battle PNG set
scopeReview.unrelatedCssCombatSaveStatsReleaseVersio: no changes found in independent diff review
scopeReview.buildOutputs: hashed boot/app-shell and manifests regenerated as required; no new layout owner or wrapper

limitations: Viewport emulation is not physical Android/iOS testing; physical pinch/long-press/touch behavior was not certified.
Firebase transport was a local read-only fixture, not a real Firebase Auth/Cloud Save acceptance test; no cloud character or player data was written.
No deployed SHA is certified by this local report; latest-head required CI and dev deployment acceptance remain the root agent's responsibility.
Appearance choices remain coupled to existing gender/element controls; no independent portrait persistence or battle asset switch was introduced.
The quality-first lossless v3 runtime set is 9,484,070 bytes; mobile download latency was not measured.
acceptedUserDirection: Stylized 2D linework and color planes, handsome/beautiful protagonists with distinctive designed shoulders, belts, bracers and hems. Human-approved male01 v3 is the style authority. Scope is creation/story portraits only; battle retains separate assets.
